data.title: US denies Pentagon leak on Israeli espionage, blames anti-Iran war sources | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: There have always been "America First" forces within the US, and even within the Pentagon, who opposed American intervention in Iran, and are angry at Israel for its role in starting the war.
